meta.name: deactivate_member
meta.description: Look up a member by ID and deactivate their account.

inputs.name: member_id
inputs.description: Member account ID to deactivate — e.g. 1001

target.reasoning: The page has a textbox for member ID and a SEARCH button. I should first type the member ID 1001 into the textbox before clicking search.

assertion.expect: The member ID textbox now contains 1001.

target.name: SEARCH
target.reasoning: Member ID 1001 has been entered into the textbox; the next step is to click the SEARCH button to retrieve the member detail.

assertion.expect: Member detail page or results for member 1001 appears.

target.name: DEACTIVATE ACCOUNT
target.reasoning: The member detail for 1001 is visible with status ACTIVE. The next step is to click the 'DEACTIVATE ACCOUNT' link to initiate deactivation.

assertion.expect: deactivation page or confirmation for member 1001 is displayed

target.name: CONFIRM
target.reasoning: We are on the confirmation page for deactivating member 1001. Click CONFIRM to complete deactivation.

assertion.expect: Account deactivation confirmation/success page is displayed.
